tests.name: GET /api/v1/wearables/providers lists >=1 provider; Settings › Connected Apps shows a health card connected only when the gateway does, Data Sync lists only real connections, no old fake sync times; Settings › Privacy data-sharing switches off + disabled, export disabled (read-only)

health cards and Data Sync from the gateway's provider list (none / Fitbit connected), source scan for hard-coded health state, mobile merge + header count, providers hook warns and degrades to [], Privacy switches and export disabled
tests.reason: Showing a health app as connected depends on the member's own wearable connections, and staging is read-only against the production Supabase project, so the staging spec can only prove the not-connected path for the test user (or whatever it really has). These Vitests render the real Connected Apps and Privacy pages with a mocked provider list and prove both the empty and the Fitbit-connected cases, the mobile merge and the hook's warn-and-degrade path.
